name: allclear
description: Status page and basic availability monitor for Cloudflare's serverless platform

scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix apps/api run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/shared run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck

comment: Deliberately NOT an npm workspaces monorepo. Each package installs its own dependencies. M0 exists to validate the vinext/Workers deployment path, and hoisting the beta vinext + @cloudflare/vite-plugin dependency tree would add an unrelated variable. Revisit after M0.
